topic.title: [中文｜Chinese edition] the rules of the Pokémon Trading Card Game

messages.content:
https://www.pokemon.cn/tcg-rules-howtoplay

我以前完全没有接触过宝可梦卡牌，以前玩万智牌和炉石传说多，当然因为猎魔人接触到了昆特牌，我对卡牌类的的基础也就是这些。我找到了官方的中文版规则介绍，希望能对中文玩家有帮助。

I'm new to the Pokémon TCG. I've mostly played Magic: The Gathering and Hearthstone before, and of course I also got into Gwent through The Witcher. I found the official Chinese version of the rulebook, hoping it will be helpful for Chinese players.
